title: Mechanisms of cellular senescence combined with molecular docking strategies: A biomarker study of potential therapeutic targets for allergic rhinitis.
authors: Chen, Qingyong; Zhang, Han; Wu, Yue; Liu, Jixin; Wang, Dongqing; Sun, Dezhong; Chen, Zhipeng; Lin, Liqiang; Lv, Huaiqing; Shao, Qiang
one_liner_zh: 该文用生物信息学筛选过敏性鼻炎衰老相关Hub基因，并用分子对接验证药物-蛋白互作，但核心是基因表达与疾病标志物，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Bioinformatics and molecular docking methods were used to screen potential biomarkers of cellular senescence in allergic rhinitis (Allergic rhinitis AR), which provided a theoretical basis for revealing the mechanism of AR and exploring new therapeutic approaches. METHODS: Four AR-related gene chips (GSE19187, GSE43523, GSE44037, and GSE51392) were downloaded from the gene expression database (GEO) for data pooling. Screening differential genes (DEGs) were taken to intersect with cellular senescence-related genes (SRGs) to obtain differential senescence genes (DESRGs). The differential senescence genes were subjected to Gene Ontology Database (GO) functional analysis, Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway analysis, and GSEA enrichment analysis. Protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks were constructed through the STRING database, MCODE plugin weights were analyzed to identify important gene cluster modules, and Hub genes were screened using the CytoHubba plugin topological network algorithm. Hub gene protein interactions network (GeneMANIA) was constructed by the GeneMANIA database. Predict Hub gene construct mRNA-miNA-lncRNA interactions by miRanda, miRDB, miRWalk, TargetScan, and spongeScan databases; construct Hub gene transcription factor regulatory networks by TRRUST database; analyze Hub gene-drug interactions by DGIdb database and select commonly used drugs in the clinic for molecular docking validation. RESULTS: A total of 264 differential genes were screened in the training set with corrected P.adj < 0.05 and |log2FC| >/= 1.2 as the filtering condition, and a total of 866 cellular senescence genes, and 20 differential senescence genes (DESRGs) were obtained by taking the intersection of the two. A total of 19 Hub genes were obtained after PPI analysis, which were CCL2, STAT1, TLR2, IGFBP3, TLR3, KLF4, IL1RN, IRF1, SERPINB2, DPP4, MME, NQO1, SAMHD1, XAF1, PHGDH, EIF4EBP1, CTH, HSPA2, AHR The gene-protein interaction network identified 19 Hub genes associated with 21 functional proteins. 5 of the Hub gene loci were associated with 29 miRNAs and 53 lncRNAs. The transcription factor regulatory network obtained 15 transcription factors capable of regulating Hub genes. The analysis of drug-gene interactions identified 489 drugs that target hub genes. For example, in the case of budesonide, the interacting genes STAT1, TLR2, TLR3, and AHR were selected for molecular docking. Similarly, for mometasone, the interacting genes TLR2 and CTH were chosen for molecular docking. CONCLUSION: Mining AR-related Hub senescence genes by bioinformatics analysis, constructing PPI network, ceRNA network, transcription factor regulatory network, gene-drug interaction network and molecular docking validation, we screened 19 CCL2, STAT1, TLR2, IGFBP3, TLR3, KLF4, IL1RN, IRF1, SERPINB2, DPP4, MME, NQO1, SAMHD1, XAF1, PHGDH, EIF4EBP1, CTH, HSPA2, and AHR are expected to be Hub genes for potential diagnostic and therapeutic biomarkers, which will provide targets and new insights for further in-depth explorations of AR cellular senescence-related mechanisms of action and therapy.
abstract_zh: 目的：采用生物信息学和分子对接方法筛选过敏性鼻炎（Allergic rhinitis AR）中细胞衰老的潜在生物标志物，为揭示AR机制和探索新的治疗方法提供理论基础。方法：从基因表达数据库（GEO）下载4个AR相关基因芯片（GSE19187、GSE43523、GSE44037和GSE51392）进行数据合并。筛选差异基因（DEGs）与细胞衰老相关基因（SRGs）取交集，获得差异衰老基因（DESRGs）。对差异衰老基因进行基因本体数据库（GO）功能分析、京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）通路分析和GSEA富集分析。通过STRING数据库构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络，分析MCODE插件权重以识别重要基因簇模块，并使用CytoHubba插件拓扑网络算法筛选Hub基因。通过GeneMANIA数据库构建Hub基因蛋白质相互作用网络（GeneMANIA）。通过miRanda、miRDB、miRWalk、TargetScan和spongeScan数据库预测Hub基因构建mRNA-miRNA-lncRNA相互作用；通过TRRUST数据库构建Hub基因转录因子调控网络；通过DGIdb数据库分析Hub基因-药物相互作用，并选择临床常用药物进行分子对接验证。结果：以校正后P.adj < 0.05和|log2FC| ≥ 1.2为筛选条件，在训练集中共筛选出264个差异基因，共获得866个细胞衰老基因，取两者交集得到20个差异衰老基因（DESRGs）。PPI分析后共获得19个Hub基因，分别为CCL2、STAT1、TLR2、IGFBP3、TLR3、KLF4、IL1RN、IRF1、SERPINB2、DPP4、MME、NQO1、SAMHD1、XAF1、PHGDH、EIF4EBP1、CTH、HSPA2、AHR。基因-蛋白质相互作用网络识别出19个Hub基因与21个功能蛋白相关。Hub基因位点中的5个与29个miRNA和53个lncRNA相关。转录因子调控网络获得15个能够调控Hub基因的转录因子。药物-基因相互作用分析识别出489种靶向Hub基因的药物。例如，对于布地奈德，选择相互作用的基因STAT1、TLR2、TLR3和AHR进行分子对接。同样，对于莫米松，选择相互作用的基因TLR2和CTH进行分子对接。结论：通过生物信息学分析挖掘AR相关Hub衰老基因，构建PPI网络、ceRNA网络、转录因子调控网络、基因-药物相互作用网络并进行分子对接验证，我们筛选出19个基因（CCL2、STAT1、TLR2、IGFBP3、TLR3、KLF4、IL1RN、IRF1、SERPINB2、DPP4、MME、NQO1、SAMHD1、XAF1、PHGDG、EIF4EBP1、CTH、HSPA2和AHR），有望成为潜在诊断和治疗生物标志物的Hub基因，这将为进一步深入探索AR细胞衰老相关作用机制和治疗提供靶点和新见解。
